title: Index ArcAgentEscrow events
summary: Build a small event indexer that reads JobCreated, DeliverableSubmitted, JobApproved, JobDisputed, JobRefunded, and DisputeResolved events from an Arc Testnet deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: The indexer can start from a configured block number.
The indexer persists events with jobId, actor addresses, amount, URI fields, and transaction hash.
The README includes setup and replay instructions.
